definitions.explanation: The act of changing from one set of clothes to another.
A set of clothes prepared for changing into, such as clean clothes brought on a trip or kept at work.

examples.japanese: {着替|きが}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to get changed.

examples.english: I change into my uniform before the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{更衣室|こういしつ}→更衣室：07042_kouishitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{着替|きが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませて→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。

examples.english: I prepared two sets of spare clothes for the trip.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{汚|よご}す→汚す：02327_yogosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{着替|きが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Children get dirty quickly, so it's better to pack extra changes of clothes.

notes:
USAGE:
{着替|きが}え is a noun derived from the verb {着替|きが}える (to change clothes). It can refer either to the act of changing or to the clothes themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着替|きが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to bring a change of clothes)
- {着替|きが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to finish changing)
- {着替|きが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ (to prepare spare clothes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧ refers to the seasonal switch of wardrobes, not daily changing of clothes. {着替|きが}える is the verb form meaning to change clothes.
